about.text: Hi, I'm Ayush Pandey — a developer passionate about building scalable web applications and exploring the intersection of software and hardware. Currently pursuing my B.Tech in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering at MITS Gwalior, I combine analytical problem-solving with hands-on software development. My core strength lies in full-stack web development and programming, along with a deep understanding of core electronics and hardware-software integration.

Responsive HTML/CSS/JavaScript interface

projects.title: IEEE Webpage
projects.description: A responsive, accessible event registration portal built for IEEE MTT-S workshops, featuring domain-specific track selection, drag-and-drop document uploads, and comprehensive client-side form validation.
points: Architected a modern, fully responsive user interface using semantic HTML5 and custom modular CSS3.
Implemented structured form sections tailored for IEEE MTT-S tracks including RF, Microwave, Antenna, and Signal Processing.
Engineered robust client-side input validation using RegEx for strict email and 10-digit contact number verification.
Integrated an interactive drag-and-drop resume/CV dropzone supporting multiple file formats (PDF, DOC, DOCX).
Configured dedicated form reset handlers and state mechanisms to prevent erroneous double-submissions.
Deployed statically on GitHub Pages with automated CI/CD for high availability and zero downtime.

projects.title: Real-Time Weather Dashboard
projects.description: An interactive real-time weather web application that allows users to search for any city globally and view key meteorological parameters, powered by the Open-Meteo REST API.
points: Built an intuitive, responsive web dashboard with clean UI components for global weather searching.
Integrated Open-Meteo API to fetch and render real-time temperature, humidity, wind speed, atmospheric pressure, and "feels like" metrics.
Implemented dynamic DOM updates and real-time state handling for seamless, page-refresh-free searches.
Engineered graceful error handling and loading indicators for invalid city queries or network delays.
Optimized performance with lightweight vanilla JavaScript and custom responsive CSS layouts.
Deployed the live web app using GitHub Pages for zero-cost, persistent static hosting.

projects.title: Advanced CSS3 Responsive Architecture
projects.description: A modern, modular CSS3 architecture showcasing advanced responsive layouts, CSS Grid, Flexbox systems, custom design tokens, and fluid typography tailored for seamless cross-device compatibility.
points: Architected an advanced multi-breakpoint responsive layout leveraging modern CSS Grid and Flexbox mechanics.
Engineered a scalable design token hierarchy using CSS custom properties (variables) for consistent theming and spacing.
Implemented fluid typography and clamp-based sizing to ensure optimal readability across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
Optimized render performance by strictly relying on zero-dependency, pure CSS animations, and lightweight styling rules.
Enforced cross-browser accessibility standards with high-contrast UI components, touch-friendly targets, and clean semantic markup.
Deployed the production build on GitHub Pages for high-availability static web hosting.
